notes.title: The Rich neighborhood update 1.1 is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear thieves,[/h2]
We are proud to finally deliver the new and improved American Theft 80s.
It took us a lot of time but the amount of features added is worth it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/db70613d7aba8deb2cbc9f25352492664c6184b2.png[/img]
[h1]New neighborhood[/h1]
Let’s start with the biggest part. The rich neighborhood.
Gather evidence on corrupted sheriff and mayor. Watch out for the cameras, guards and of course tennants.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/381469714b49dda97bcf535d4104e7d5dbe61921.png[/img]
[h1]New tools[/h1]
Don’t worry, you will have some new tools that will help you with new jobs.

[h3]Simple lockpick[/h3] 
-hammering handles is cool but sometimes it’s better to use a more stealth approach

[h3]Binoculars[/h3] 
-just like in our previous game, Thief Simulator, it’s important to mark important parts of the building, cameras and the people. It’s easier to do it from far away

[h3]Glass knife[/h3]
-good quiet alternative to a crowbar

[h3]Gate remote tool[/h3]
-open almost every gate with a special remote

[h3]Jewelry tools[/h3]
prepare the jewelry at the hideout or a hotel before selling it


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/fc0ccefd495b1ca44d6287e09a6a30a99f1c00db.png[/img]
[h1]New systems[/h1]
There are some big changes in the game and in the old content.

[h3]New level system[/h3]
-remade, rebalanced and more interesting

[h3]Security weak spots marking system[/h3]
-scope the place before going in, look for opened windows, easy locks and much more

[h3]Intel gathering[/h3]
-garbarge bins, letter boxes, you never know what vital information can the tenants leave in those spots

[h3]Preparing loot[/h3]
-some of the loot need’s to be prepared before selling, motel room or your home is a perfect place to do this

[h3]Thief / Robber difficulty[/h3]
-if you are looking for a harder more stealthy ways to play (like Thief Simulator) the Thief difficulty is for you, prepare to get stunned a lot (it's possible to change the difficulty in the pause menu while playing)

[h3]Quick estate info[/h3]
-press TAB key anytime to get access to tenant routines and other important stuff without checking the map

Have fun!

notes.title: Patch v1.05 - the sandbox
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
It's been two weeks since the release of American Theft 80s. We are working very hard to bring you more content, fixes and tweaks.

First big patch is here. If you feel that the game is too easy and you want more random challenges then the sandbox mode is for you. (enable hard mode for even more fun)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/26f0e1ecb6f380205fa7629e8cdf3e5eb4010271.png[/img]

To play the sandbox mode, just start a new profile.
The first thing you will notice is the lack of story. You start with no money, no tools and no tutorials.
With all the tools unlocked at the start the only thing you will need is the money to buy them.

No story and tutorials aren't the only things changed in this mode. First of all, the map changes a bit every few days. Some doors will be locked, some windows will be blocked with grates, new cameras will show up here and there. The tenants will be more random and less predictable.
When the police catch Jack there is no Game Over screen, you lose some cash, get more heat and respawn at the nearest phone booth.

What’s the end goal for the sandbox mode? Find all of the 15 golden VHS randomly placed on the map. Every time you make a new profile and start the sandbox mode they will be spawned in a different place.
After collecting them all you will get an achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/06f60bfad375d841f0d209c6abeafa6842524f31.png[/img]

We also added a new tool, a hand torch to open even the hardest locks.

By the way, most of the reported bugs should be fixed! 
We are also working on a new neighbourhood, more info soon.

Patch log:
1.05
-new mode sandbox
-new tool hand torch
-some doors can be relocked to avoid detection
-sheds added in the first map
-house furniture reset bug fix
-balancing tweaks
-underground cars should be fixed now
-other small fixes
-pricey items in town should be fixed

Have fun,
Noble Muffins team

notes.title: NEXT FEST STREAM! CHECK OUT HOW WE PLAY!
notes.content:
Can't make up your mind if it's worth the download?
Check out how we play American Thef 80s. Not the first time we are stealing from people (and probably not the last). You can learn a lot from us in that department!

notes.title: Devlog #10 Classic cars
notes.content:
We are huge fans of the 80s shows aesthetics. That’s why we decided to have fun and put some of the most iconic vehicles known from those shows into our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/44232970db6cc1af429112ef94e0c856884f208c.jpg[/img]

Sun, ocean, beautiful women and fast cars. Put on your best suit and drive into the sunset in this sports car.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/94158a78d29742898f99777637155f279c12134b.jpg[/img]

Your name is not Michael but you can still drive his car. Maybe it can’t talk nor give clever comebacks but it’s still a great way to look awesome driving in the middle of the night.

What are your favorite 80s shows?

notes.title: Devlog #9 The disguises
notes.content:
Getting inside houses, banks and other buildings doesn’t always require breaking in.
Sometimes just talking with people will help you with your job.

But wearing your standard clothes won’t get you anywhere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/48e67d6f786ec95383e87dd635df17b9ffb3e3a0.png[/img]


That’s why you need to disguise yourself. Some tenants can be easily deceived by wearing simple electrician clothes. Just tell them there is a wiring failure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/c0aa1cf03ebfd83d6442399a5e08f8d733381199.png[/img]

There are other types of clothes that can help with hiding from sight, but you’ve got to respect the dress code! As an example, you want to wear black clothes in the middle of the night. Just don’t forget to change back later, you don’t want to look shady all the time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/e39049c6a3d4d1b504c9c91766b93bcb25baf8fe.png[/img]

These are just a few of many disguises available in the game. What kind of clothes would you like to see added?

notes.title: Devlog #8 The jobs
notes.content:
To get to the top you’ll need to do more than just rob random houses.
You will do specific jobs that will give you not only money but also reputation in the criminal underworld.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/8fa168f7e402552c335493f21692a7691e452674.png[/img]

Most of the jobs will involve stealing (that’s what the game is about, after all) but it’s not that easy. You need to learn a lot about the target: when is the best time to get in, what tools are needed and is there a dog guarding the place, or maybe a camera?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/29855bd5a2a5fd9d2dd1fc8d7ac0f2a56d01c93c.png[/img]

Other times you will steal cars. It’s more tricky because most of them will be parked in locked garages or behind a gate. The client will ask for a specific car and sometimes it’s the one harder to get.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/4f57295728818565eff35dc47a79b008d92faeb3.png[/img]

Sometimes you will need to disguise yourself to infiltrate a bank, museum or even a mansion. Stealing data or jewelry is possible even without a backpack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/9e893733559eff80518f2c21d2bed9416f5e8fdb.png[/img]

Those are just a few of many jobs (or quests if you prefer the classic naming) you will do in the game. If you have an idea for some cool stuff to do, let us know!

notes.title: Devlog #7 The tools
notes.content:
A thief can’t do anything without his tools.
Of course he still needs to be clever on how to use them.

First one is the not so civilised hammer.
If you need something broken (like door handles) it can be quite useful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/e2169ebe6a1378be8ebafc865007e54d0d74b9de.png[/img]

Next one is the classic crowbar. If you need a window open it’s your tool of choice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/26f33e90e1eeaf688fccfd5d3e790299bc8066ff.png[/img]

Most of the time you will want to get stuff quietly. For that you can use good old lockpicks. Mastering them is the key to fast heist.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/df693f758cfe0daf7eab1ff02e588c6a9e13e878.png[/img]

If you’re not that good, there is always an easier tool. Automatic lockpick is a faster and better version of the standard lockpick.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/2615f285f3bf4d64f743bf6a8ae10afe0ec8ae80.png[/img]

From time to time you will need to cut some chains, there is no better tool than bolt cutters for that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/5f46363d56fb9b30bf2102964c62315066086b49.png[/img]

These are just a few of many tools that you can use in American Theft. What tools would you like us to add?

notes.title: Devlog #6 The characters
notes.content:
Apart from stealing for money, players will meet interesting characters and possibly do some shady jobs for them.

One of the first “employers” will be a guy named Sly Ed. He usually hangs out in the Bar 66.
He’s not the biggest fish out there but he will be useful to get more contacts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/de2540ddbb2e5008989baa2d87890bfbcac4294e.png[/img]

He’s also a manager of a heavy metal guitarist also known as Joel “The Spine Drinker”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/370406d30aacfa9c9357fa1f3112c2dd1ff0ab81.png[/img]

On the other side of the law we have a vengeful Chief Wells.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/a2e3cbefc198cade3422a7ea8cc828e5e4459288.png[/img]

And the man above him - mayor of Shady Woods, Roy McConnell. We all know that as a politician he must be righteous, selfless and law abiding citizen, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/66bf6349eb55e5917ddac99116ee131d15106605.png[/img]

There are more interesting characters that our hero will encounter. Meanwhile, let us know what are your favourite characters from 80’s movies!

notes.title: Devlog #5 The locations
notes.content:
Open world stealing game of course needs some interesting locations.
But before you get inside huge mansions you got to start with something easier.

Those trailers look easy enough. But they usually don’t have much inside.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/a3e1d8ab8f255d4011ea380f4727abacb5070001.png[/img]

Small houses like that are a great way to learn more about stealing. For sure they have a TV or two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/59a556edc66ebc78825ab6a7c282f354c960435c.png[/img]

On the other hand, a gas station should have some cash in the storage room in the back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/dcb87ca791aa2cc71eb67cf9ff390c5feab22ede.png[/img]

A friendly neighborhood can have some pricey jewelry just waiting to get stolen.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/b03349a0790bb192f6c82be82642debc72ebfb74.png[/img]

And of course don’t forget about banks and city apartments, while not easy they will provide you with enough cash to buy a car, maybe even a house if you get lucky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/f6c4e9d641ba9b4da4b5a29fe74f8fb4414924f5.png[/img]

Of course we have more in the making. What would you like to steal from?

notes.title: Devlog #4 The cars
notes.content:
Cars in American Theft 80s are important in many ways. Not only will they get you from point A to B but are also essential in theft.

You start with an old car. It’s slow but it will help you to transport TVs and other big items to the pawn shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/13707cf60002479c744ccdd6e2065d0b13e288b6.png[/img]

After you earn some more cash you can buy other cars. Some of them are fast and will help you to get away from the cops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/fc6429d7072d80446b2c5e959996a0a44eb716f5.png[/img]

Other cars can be great transport vehicles if you plan to take a lot of loot in one trip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/0193abf39f1e420697875c34471aa34440590463.png[/img]

But you’re a thief after all so buying cars isn’t the only option to get them. Be careful though, police will look for them and sometimes it’s just better to get rid of them as fast as possible. That doesn’t stop you from getting some cash out of it, of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/e5d36bad74b30b5d90f3552cfbb8573beca358ba.png[/img]

Let us know what classic cars would you like to see in the game?

notes.title: Devlog #3 The items
notes.content:
What would a game about stealing be without nice loot.

On your way to become rich you’re going to have to start with something less valuable - like vhs tapes or cassettes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/01fb77d073d2d256dba68b4e1baae8cae6f7f659.png[/img]

But those aren’t all 80s flavored items that you can “obtain”. Look out for classic consoles, VCRs or a cool looking electric guitar. It’s all out there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/b86ca5ad69b18a4a9c15d787bc591b83589ffb4d.png[/img]

But all that wouldn’t be worth the effort if it wasn’t for a friendly businessman that will gladly buy those artifacts. Maybe the price is not great but it’s better than nothing, I guess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/e81dbafcd9865666d5cf5d6d0d315f57c2ea1aae.png[/img]

As the game progresses you will also find jewelry, art and a lot more actually valuable items.
Let us know what items you would like to steal (not in real life, of course, that would be illegal).

notes.title: DEVLOG #2 - The heists
notes.content:
In American Theft 80s it’s not always about invading homes. 
Sometimes our hero needs to do a bigger job.

We’re talking about heists. Sneaky ones, of course. You can’t go in all guns blazing - you need a good plan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/7b0e7b4769ce7a6d5777f9e501d519a92b62a792.png[/img]

Breaking in is not as simple as it seems, so look out for openings. Now, if someone would leave a window open, that might be your chance to get in...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/d135564f283496d02bb362e2fd9ad89ff8431dbf.png[/img]

Ok, now you’re in but we’re not there yet! Avoid the guards, they will not only call the police but also try to stop you by using brute force.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/0c0b4bf75b2aacafddb0e0ac957c7376d563c12b.png[/img]

Other things to watch out for are cameras. Always look around and peek around the corner, you never know where they installed those.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/e1794e4fc89cce0b3cb7a13e0bb0cd04d6e48a54.png[/img]

We’re almost there, but banks don’t keep money under the pillow. The vaults are hard to open but well worth the effort. Don’t worry, you’ve got a friend in drill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/eb7a0cb22aaae926ba0b5b001e489aa5dc9f0da9.png[/img]

That’s all for today folks, stay tuned for more!

notes.title: DEVLOG #1 - The movies
notes.content:
In American Theft 80s we are all about giving you the feel of those times. 
As we all know, the 80s had some of the most iconic movies ever.
We needed to include them in our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/f68deab1c70b417cea705f8c982a12277a54e067.png[/img]

Yes, we do have the famous Toiletnator, Dambo and even Fat Max.
Ahh the classics, just thinking of them takes me back to my childhood.

Simply having those posters wouldn’t be fun would it?
Steal one of each to get an Achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38911858/53974dabe07c789ba70caa0bbb1fae27a65265a0.png[/img]

You can also buy a home and place the posters on the wall, show everyone you’ve got great taste in movies.

Let us know what 80s movies do you love, maybe we will add them to the game.
